description: Returns the public booking or inquiry route for a business. Use this before helping a user book an appointment: it distinguishes an external provider page, an active configured calendar using Advocate, an eligible quote-request form when neither booking route is available, and businesses with no supported destination. For native mode, booking_backend names the calendar Advocate books into and capabilities states whether availability, booking, cancellation and rescheduling are supported through Advocate. Cancellation is per booking: cancel_booking needs the cancel_token confirm_booking returned, or the one in a paid booking's payment receipt, so an agent cannot cancel a booking made on the page or one whose token it never received. External pages are links only; Advocate does not sync their availability or make bookings there. Request mode opens an editable form; sending requires explicit customer consent and confirms no time, price, payment, or booking.
name: get_booking_destination

booking_backend.description: Native mode only: which calendar Advocate books into for this business.

capabilities.description: Native mode only: what an agent can complete through Advocate for this backend. Unsupported actions have no tool; do not claim them.

title: Get Booking Destination
